title: Lead UI/UX Designer
description:
As the UX Lead for our ServiceNow platform, you will drive consistency across our UX and UI, document and own the standards that get us there, and build the design system and practice that make great experiences repeatable
   

  

 rather than accidental. This is a hands on leadership role. You will set the design direction and build it, in UI Builder and in React.
   

  

 This is a pivotal moment for experience on our platform. We are raising our ambition from enterprise tolerable to consumer grade, moving beyond a traditional ITSM mindset to design solutions our users genuinely want to use.You will own the success and adoption of what we ship, not just the design behind it.
   

  

 You will establish a formal UX practice on the platform from the ground up and lead the designers and developers
   

  

 who join it. Strong stakeholder management and communication are central to the role. You will be the advocate for experience who aligns product, engineering, and business around a shared bar for quality, and holds us to it.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 UX Standards and Consistency
   

  

* Own and document the UX and UI standards for the platform, and drive their adoption across every team building on ServiceNow.
* Build and own a design system and component library so that consistency is built in, not policed after the fact.
* Establish design patterns, guidelines, and reusable components that raise the floor on every solution we ship.
* Define what “good” looks like on the platform and hold teams to it through design reviews and clear standards.


 Consumer Grade Experience and Adoption
   

  

* Move the platform beyond a traditional ITSM mindset and design solutions where the experience is consumer grade.
* Own the success and adoption of the solutions we ship. Define what adoption looks like, measure it, and use


 it to drive design decisions.
   

  

* Partner with product and business teams to make sure we are solving the real user problem, not just delivering the requested feature.
* Bring an outside\-in view of quality, benchmarked against the consumer products our users actually compare us to.


 Hands On Design and Build
   

  

* Design and build experiences directly in UI Builder and the Now Experience Framework.
* Write front\-end code in React to build components, prototypes, and production experiences where native tooling is not enough.
* Move fluidly between design and implementation so that what gets shipped matches what was designed.
* Set front\-end engineering standards for the UX work on the platform.


 User Research and Accessibility
   

  

* Stand up a user research practice. Talk to real users, run usability testing, and bring evidence to design decisions rather than opinion.
* Own accessibility on the platform. Make sure what we build meets WCAG standards and works for everyone, and build accessibility into the design system rather than retrofitting it.
* Turn research and accessibility from checkboxes into a genuine part of how the team works.


 Mobile Experience
   

  

* Extend the same consumer grade bar to mobile. Our mobile experience is a strength today and this role keeps it that way as the platform grows.
* Design and build mobile experiences that are first class, not afterthoughts, across ServiceNow mobile apps and mobile web.


 Building the UX Practice and Team
   

  

* Establish a formal UX practice on the platform from scratch: the standards, the tools, the rituals, and the ways of working.
* Hire, lead, and grow a team of UX designers and developers, and build a culture where craft and user obsession are the norm.
* Mentor the team and raise the level of design and front\-end work across everyone building on the platform.


 Stakeholder Management and Communication
   

  

* Be the advocate for experience across product, engineering, operations, and business, and align them around a shared bar for quality.
* Communicate design decisions clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, including executive leadership, and bring people along rather than mandating.
* Make the case for investment in UX and show the return through adoption and outcomes.

description:
AI can make a polished screen in seconds. Getting someone to trust an AI agent with their real work is much harder. That's the problem we're hiring for.
 



  





 At Tipstat, we build AI systems that run whole business workflows. Our two products are Ozyn.AI, a productivity assistant that works across Gmail, CRM, Calendar, Sheets and 50\+ other integrations, and Alvoff, an AI\-native B2B procurement platform. * Talk to users every week, watch session recordings and dig into data to find the gap between what people say and what they actually do
* Design trust between people and AI agents: when an agent acts on its own and when it asks first, how it shows its work, and how users take back control
* Shape behavior, not just screens, using motivation, habit, cognitive load and deliberate friction
* Own the whole journey: onboarding, empty states, errors, notifications, emails and pricing
* Give our products a distinct feel instead of the generic SaaS look, and back your choices with evidence
* Tie design to activation, adoption of agent workflows and retention, and run experiments to learn what works and why

* Work with founders and engineering to shape the roadmap
* Build our experience principles, design system and research practice



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 6\+ years in product design or UX, ideally in B2B SaaS or complex workflow tools
* Deep working knowledge of user psychology and behavioral design. You can explain why a design works, not just that it looks good
* Research skills you actually use: interviews, usability testing and product analytics
* Strong craft in interaction design, information architecture and visual design
* Clear writing. You treat microcopy as part of the design
* Comfort with ambiguity and with being the only designer in the room
* Hands\-on experience with AI design and prototyping tools

title: Marketing Designer
description:
Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology company building AI\-powered intelligence for the freight forwarding industry. Freight forwarders manage thousands of shipments, rates, exceptions, and operational decisions every day. The challenge is not a lack of data. It is knowing what needs attention, what is going wrong, and what action to take next.
   

  

 Portcast uses AI and data to help freight forwarders surface shipment exceptions, identify cost and margin risks, and make better decisions across the shipment lifecycle. Our products help teams improve operational efficiency, protect margins, and make faster, more informed decisions. Our vision is to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.
   

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**
 We are looking for a Marketing Designer to be the design engine behind our marketing. You'll turn briefs and copy into polished, on\-brand assets across the full funnel, landing pages, case studies, social and paid creative, event materials, product collateral, and video, often at speed and across several formats at once. You'll partner closely with content and growth marketing (copy and content sit with the Content Marketing Manager; the visual craft is yours) to keep a consistent visual system across everything we publish, and raise the bar on how the Portcast brand shows up.
   

  

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:**
* A consistent, high\-quality visual system across everything Portcast publishes, with assets shipped quickly and on\-brand across web, print, social, paid, and video, so marketing can move fast without design becoming a bottleneck or losing craft.


**WHAT YOU’LL OWN:**
* Design landing pages, case study PDFs, product one\-pagers, and sales/product collateral
* Produce social creative (LinkedIn\-first), including post series and campaign templates
* Build paid media and creative for LinkedIn and Google campaigns across personas
* Create event and webinar assets: banners, booth graphics, decks
* Produce and edit video content end to end, short\-form social clips, product feature videos, webinar/event recaps, and launch teasers, from raw footage to polished, on\-brand output
* Maintain and extend the Portcast brand system: components, tokens, templates
* Support HTML email/newsletter production and light web design handoff
* Iterate quickly across multiple design and content review rounds


**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent
* At least 3\+ years in a design role, ideally in\-house at a B2B SaaS product\-based startup or at an agency doing B2B marketing, with a portfolio that shows real range across web, print, social, campaign, and video work
* Fast, high\-craft execution: You produce polished work quickly, often across several formats at once, without letting speed erode quality. You take direction and iterate well, but you hold your own opinions on what "good" looks like
* Detail\-obsessed: Pixel alignment, spacing, and consistency matter to you. You catch the small things others miss and hold the visual bar across everything that ships
* Figma (advanced): You work fluently with components, variants, auto\-layout, and shared libraries, and you keep the design system clean and reusable
* Adobe Creative Suite: Strong in Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign, including multi\-page, print\-ready layouts for case studies and collateral
* Design fundamentals: A strong grasp of typography, layout, grid systems, and brand consistency, and the ability to design for web and print formats interchangeably
* Creative at scale: You're comfortable designing social and paid ad creative at volume from templates, keeping everything on\-brand across personas and campaigns
* Video editing and production: You can take a project from raw footage to finished, high\-quality output, cutting, pacing, color, captions/subtitles, motion titles, and sound. You're fluent in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (or equivalent DaVinci Resolve / Final Cut), and CapCut or similar for fast short\-form social edits
* Web and email handoff: A basic understanding of HTML/CSS, enough to work within existing markup for email and web handoff, not necessarily coding from scratch
* Brand systems: Working knowledge of brand systems and design tokens, and how to keep every asset on\-system as the brand scales
* Advanced motion design: animation and motion work (Lottie, complex After Effects, 3D/Blender)
* Presentation design: high\-polish decks in PowerPoint or Google Slides
* AI design tooling: familiarity with image generation, AI\-assisted layout, prompt\-based workflows, and AI video
* Webflow basics: building or maintaining pages in Webflow, not just designing them
* Curiosity for the logistics domain: Experiencein logistics, supply chain, transportation, or freight technology is valued, but so is a genuine curiosity to understand our market in depth
* AI\-forward mindset: You consistently apply AI across design workflows and actively experiment with new tools as they emerge
* Startup builder mentality: You thrive in lean, fast\-moving environments where ownership is high and resources are limited
* Strong communicator: You communicate clearly across a diverse, distributed, cross\-cultural team. You can be opinionated, but you engage with other views and compromise when it's right


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**
* Own the visual craft end to end: You'll own how Portcast looks and feels across everything we publish, with real influence over the brand and few layers between an idea and what ships.
* Build in an industry still defining modern B2B marketing: Logistics and supply chain tech is at an exciting stage of digital transformation, with significant room to rethink how enterprise software is marketed and how it looks. You'll bring fresh ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and help shape what great design looks like in this space.
* Work at the intersection of AI, design, and logistics: We have a strong product, established enterprise customers, and a real opportunity to sharpen how we show up. You'll get to push AI\-forward design and video workflows, not just execute templates.
* Small by design, fully distributed across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Your work directly shapes launches, customer perception, and how the market sees Portcast.


**OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO:**
* Curiosity: We dig into why a design worked or didn't, how a freight forwarder actually operates, and what makes our brand land with customers.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait to be told what to make, and we stay on a piece until it's genuinely on\-brand and right.
* Raising the bar: We don't settle for assets that are merely fine. We hold a high standard for craft, polish, and the experience our brand creates.
* Effectiveness: We focus on design that drives real marketing outcomes, pipeline, launches, and brand perception, not just output. We prioritize the right work and make practical trade\-offs.


 Join us at Portcast and help shape the future of the logistics and shipping industry through design that is as sharp as the product behind it.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. **About Runable:**

 This is a small team, so you will own product areas outright rather than decorating someone else's flows. Expect to sit with real customer problems, work directly with engineers, and see your designs live within weeks. Our users are non\-technical and time\-poor — every unnecessary step you remove is the actual output of this role.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 




  




* Own end\-to\-end design for product areas: problem framing, user flows, wireframes, high\-fidelity UI, and prototypes.

* Work directly with engineers through implementation, reviewing builds and fixing the gap between design and shipped UI.

* Run lightweight research and usability testing — talk to users, watch them struggle, change the design.

**Requirements:** 




  




* 4–8 years designing digital products, with a portfolio of shipped work — not concept pieces.

* Strong UI craft: layout, typography, hierarchy, colour, and spacing discipline you can explain rather than eyeball.
* Genuine UX ability: you can map a flow, simplify a process, and justify structure with user reasoning.
* Expert in Figma — components, auto\-layout, variants, and prototypes that engineers can actually work from.
* Experience designing SaaS, dashboards, or complex workflow tools where information density is a real problem.
* Working understanding of front\-end constraints and comfortable collaborating closely with engineers.
* Experience building or contributing to a design system.
* Comfortable using AI tools to move faster — exploring directions, generating assets, and cutting production time.

**Nice to Have:** 




  




* Startup experience where you were the only or first designer.
* Experience designing for non\-technical or SMB audiences.
* Interaction and motion design skill (Rive, Lottie, After Effects, or Figma's motion tooling).
* Ability to build with front\-end code or AI app builders to ship simple things yourself.
* Illustration, iconography, or brand design range.

**Why Runable:** 




  




* Real ownership: your design decisions ship, and you see how SMB customers respond within weeks.

* Direct access to founders and customers; short feedback loops, minimal process.
* Room to shape the design system and the product's visual direction as we scale.
* Compensation is benchmarked to experience and impact, and discussed openly in the first conversation.

title: Game Designer
description:
We’re looking for a sharp, highly driven game designer who knows mobile free\-to\-play games inside out and is genuinely excited about building AI games. If you can take an idea from a rough prototype to a live game players love, we want to talk.
 



  





**Our mission:** 




 We want to build the first globally competitive games studio out of India, one that can go head to head with Timi/Tencent, Supercell, and Activision Blizzard.
 



 Greatness, for us, means taking on hard problems and refusing to settle. We care about it in the games we ship, and even more in the people and the company we’re building. We’re not there yet. We’re looking for someone exceptional to help us get there.
 



  





**Role \& key responsibilities:** 




 Veteran or up\-and\-comer. What we care about is your skill, your drive, and how much you love games.
 


* **Design for mobile free\-to\-play.** 
 Own gameplay, core loops, progression, and metagame for our mobile F2P games, across midcore, RPG, roguelike, and whatever genre fits the idea. Build systems that hook players in the first session and keep them coming back for months: retention, economy, and a session flow that feels right on a phone.
* **Take games from idea to live.** 
 Prototype fast, test, ship. You’ll be hands\-on across the whole arc, from early prototype through soft launch and into live operation, and you’ll drive the game from concept to live, not just individual features.
* **Build with AI by default.** 
 Use AI as a core part of how you work, not a bolt\-on. Prototype mechanics, generate and test content, and tighten your iteration loop with it. And because we build AI games, you’ll help design experiences that only work
 *because* 
 AI sits at the center of them. We expect you to stay ahead of what these tools can do.
* **Design documentation.** 
 Write clear specs and feature docs that tell the team exactly how a mechanic, system, control, or piece of content should work.
* **Quality \& polish.** 
 Hold the quality bar. Work closely with engineers and artists so every feature and asset feels great in players’ hands.
* **Market analysis.** 
 Study the top mobile F2P games across genres. Pull apart what makes them work, from monetization to live\-ops to feature design, and turn that into sharp breakdowns that feed our own decisions.
* **Playtesting \& feedback.** 
 Run internal and external playtests. Gather feedback and gameplay data, read what players are actually telling you, and iterate.



  





**What we’re looking for:** 



* **You live in mobile F2P.** 
 You play the best mobile F2P games and understand why they make money and why people stay. Economy, retention, and monetization aren’t mysteries; they’re how you think about design.
* **You’re a builder who ships.** 
 You’ve taken something from nothing to done. You’d rather get a rough version in front of players this week than polish a doc for a month.
* **You’re genuinely pro\-AI.** 
 You’re excited about AI in games and in the craft of making them. You try new tools, find where they give you an edge, and you’re drawn to the kinds of games AI now makes possible.
* **High IQ and problem\-solving.** 
 Serious intellectual horsepower. You take messy design problems apart and come back with smart, systematic answers.
* **Clear, organized writer.** 
 You write specs other people can actually follow.
* **Curious and growth\-oriented.** 
 You’re always learning: new techniques, new games, new tools. You treat feedback and hard problems as the reason you’re here.
* **Analytical.** 
 You’re comfortable with data. You can break down a system or a pile of player feedback, find the pattern, and back your calls with reasoning.
* **Detail\-oriented.** 
 You sweat the small stuff that turns a good game into a great one.
* **Show us what you’ve built.** 
 Junior or senior, you have to demonstrate real design ability: shipped games, personal projects, mods, game jam entries, writing, anything that shows how you think and what you can make.

title: Product Engineer(2 to 5 Yrs)
description:
Framsikt Technologies is looking for a Product Engineer to join our high\-performing R\&D center in Bangalore. This isn’t a standard development role—this is for an engineer who wants to build great products, work closely with Product and Design, and grow into an independent, end\-to\-end product engineer in an AI\-native engineering environment.
 



  





  





**The Mission:** 




  





 Framsikt is a critical pillar of the Visma Group, one of Europe's leading software companies. Our mission is direct and high\-stakes: we power the technology behind Norway’s public sector management. Our platform is the central nervous system for strategic planning and financial workflows for over 300 municipalities, enabling data\-driven decisions that impact the lives of 5\.4 million citizens.
 



  





 When you build here, your code ensures that schools are funded, infrastructure is planned, and public resources are optimized for an entire nation. This isn't just another SaaS product; it's the digital foundation of a society.
   





  





**The Role: Autonomy \& AI\-First Development** 




  





 We are moving past the era of "manual" coding.
 



  





 At Framsikt, we expect engineers to use AI as a core part of how they build software. As a Developing Product Engineer, you will build production features while learning to use AI coding tools, agentic workflows, and context engineering to make your development faster and more effective.
 



  





 You will work with experienced engineers to solve problems, make sound technical decisions, and gradually take greater ownership of features from discovery through production.
 



  




* Build AI\-first: Use AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Devin, or Windsurf for coding, debugging, testing, refactoring, and documentation.
* Build for scale: Apply common engineering patterns across architecture, APIs, data, security, and performance with guidance from experienced engineers.
* Engineer the context: Write structured prompts, provide the right codebase context and constraints, and learn how to guide AI tools towards reliable outcomes.
* Own quality: Write unit tests, contribute to CI/CD, participate in code reviews, and use observability tools to understand and improve production systems.
* Shape the product: Partner closely with Product and Design, bring technical thinking into discovery, and turn prototypes into production with speed and clarity.



  





**The Engineering Culture: Deep Focus over Shallow Output** 




  





 We despise "the feature factory." Our Bangalore R\&D center is a high\-trust, low\-overhead environment designed for engineers who love their craft. We prioritize deep work and systems thinking. You will find a flat hierarchy where the best idea wins, regardless of tenure.
 



  





 We actively encourage "breaking things" in the pursuit of better LLM orchestration and agentic design paradigms. If you are the type of engineer who spends their weekends experimenting with new model evaluations or building custom CLI tools to automate your own job, you will be among peers here.
 



  

  





**What You’ll Bring?** 




  





**Eligibility** 




  




* Education : Any professional technical graduation or masters
* 2\+ years of engineering excellence, ideally with C\#, SQL, Angular, and TypeScript (Azure is a plus)
* We are technology\-agnostic and value strong engineering fundamentals above specific technology experience, as long as you are open to working with the Microsoft technology stack mentioned above.
* Good at problem solving, curious soul and ability to learn quickly and agile



  





**You are a perfect fit if you:** 




  




* Have a good foundation in software engineering, APIs, data modeling, testing, and application architecture.
* Can independently deliver well\-defined features and seek guidance when solving complex or unfamiliar problems.
* See AI coding agents as a force multiplier and are willing to make them part of your everyday engineering workflow.
* Enjoy experimenting with AI tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Devin, or Windsurf.
* Can write structured prompts and provide the context and constraints needed to get useful results from AI tools.Care about code quality, reliability, maintainability, and good engineering practices even when moving fast.
* Enjoy working closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to turn ideas and prototypes into production.
* Are comfortable receiving feedback, learning from experienced engineers, and taking increasing ownership of your work.



  





**Our Culture : Built on the following core three values:** 




  




* Reliable – We deliver with ownership, quality and integrity.
* Helpful – We succeed by supporting each other and our customers.
* Engaged – We stay curious, take initiative and continuously improve.

title: Design Engineer
description:
**About Company**
 Dodo Payments is the Monetisation Engine for AI\-native products. We're a Merchant of Record \+ Billing \& Monetization platform that helps SaaS, AI, and digital businesses accept payments globally, automate billing (subscriptions, usage\-based, one\-time), and stay fully compliant with taxes and regulations in 220\+ countries.
   

  

 We absorb that complexity so our customers never have to think about it. Which means it lands in our product instead. Our users should never have to feel it.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a Design Engineer to help make Dodo Payments one of the best\-crafted products in fintech. You might be a designer who learned to code because handing off Figma was not enough, or an engineer who kept opening Figma because the interface was not good enough. Either way you care deeply about both.
   

  

 You will sit directly between design and engineering, across dashboard, checkout, billing, onboarding, analytics, and new products. You will explore ideas visually, prototype them quickly, and often build the final thing yourself. Sometimes the fastest way to answer a design question is Figma. Sometimes it is 100 lines of code.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and Build: Turn complicated payment concepts into surprisingly simple interfaces, and ship the production UI in React yourself.
* Prototyping: Explore and validate interactions quickly, before we commit engineering time to them.
* Interface Craft: Obsess over typography, hierarchy, density, motion, and state. Use motion and interaction where they genuinely improve understanding, and not where they do not.
* 0 to 1 Product: Design and build new product experiences from scratch, starting from ambiguous problems.
* Systems and Primitives: Create the components and patterns that make the rest of Dodo better, without disappearing into a design system that never ships product.
* Raising the Bar: Improve existing experiences instead of accepting "it works," and push back when something is not good enough.
* Collaboration: Work directly with engineers, product, and founders on product decisions.


 You will have a lot of room to define Dodo's visual and interaction language. We expect you to use it.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Experience: 2\+ years designing and building production web interfaces, in a role that spanned both.
* Figma: Excellent with Figma as a thinking and prototyping tool, not just a handoff surface.
* Code: Comfortable writing React and TypeScript, and shipping your own work to production.
* Visual Taste: Strong visual judgment, and the ability to explain why something works.
* Interaction and Motion: Care for how interfaces move and respond. Framer Motion, Rive, GSAP, Three.js or similar is useful, but a particular library is not the point. Being able to make the thing in your head real is.
* Speed: You prototype extremely quickly and are comfortable starting from an ambiguous problem.
* Judgment: You know when simplicity takes more work, not less.
* Team Spirit: Experience in startups or dynamic high\-growth environments is preferred.


**Why Join Us?**
* Impact: Be part of the founding team, and own how Dodo looks and feels. "Fintech has to look boring" is not an acceptable design constraint here.
* Ownership: You are not decorating finished requirements or producing mockups for someone else to interpret. You design it, you build it, you ship it.
* Growth Potential: Immense potential for personal and professional growth as the company expands.
* Equity: Competitive salary and equity package.

Bengaluru
   

  

 Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company \- a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values\-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.
   

  

**We Are Proud Of:**
* The work we do and the innovation we drive
* Our values of share, care and dare
* A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
* Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration


**The role**
 As a
 **UX Designer** 
 , you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring
 **5\-8 YEARS** 
 of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.
   

  

**You Will Thrive In This Role If You Are:**
* A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
* A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge\-sharing
* Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
* Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)


****Role Responsibilities****
 We are looking for a
 **UX Designer with 5–8 years of experience** 
 who can take ownership of the UX process and do the
 **UX heavy lifting** 
 — from understanding customer needs and business objectives to defining problems, shaping experiences, and delivering thoughtful, user\-centric solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is not just someone who creates screens. You should be able to
 **understand customers, speak their language, challenge assumptions, simplify complex problems, and translate insights into meaningful experiences.**
****What You’ll Do****
* Lead UX activities across projects, from discovery and problem definition through to final experience design.
* Understand customer needs, behaviours, pain points, motivations, and expectations.
* Conduct and support user research, interviews, workshops, journey mapping, personas, and usability testing.
* Translate customer and business requirements into clear UX strategies and solutions.
* Define information architecture, user flows, journeys, wireframes, and interaction models.
* Create prototypes and validate concepts with users and stakeholders.
* Identify usability issues and continuously improve the experience based on evidence and feedback.
* Work closely with UI designers and development teams to ensure UX intent is carried through to the final product.
* Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, and clients to align user needs with business goals.
* Present and articulate design decisions clearly, using customer and business outcomes rather than design jargon.
* Challenge existing assumptions and propose better, simpler, and more effective solutions.
* Contribute to design systems, UX standards, and reusable patterns where appropriate.


****What We’re Looking For****
**Must Have**
* 5–8 years of professional UX design experience.
* Strong understanding of human\-centred design and UX methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to independently drive UX work and take ownership of complex problems.
* Strong ability to understand customer needs and speak the customer's language.
* Experience translating ambiguous requirements into clear UX problems and actionable solutions.
* Strong skills in:
* User journeys
* Information architecture
* User flows
* Wireframing
* Prototyping
* Usability testing
* UX research
* Interaction design
* Strong communication and storytelling skills.
* Ability to explain why a design solution is right, not just what was designed.
* Experience working directly with clients, stakeholders, product teams, and developers.
* Strong proficiency in Figma or equivalent UX/design tools.


**The Person We’re Looking For**
 We value
 **problem\-solvers over screen\-makers** 
 .
   

  

**You Should Be Someone Who:**
* Starts with the customer problem, not the UI.
* Is comfortable asking “Why?” and challenging the brief when needed.
* Can turn complex business requirements into simple customer experiences.
* Can work with incomplete information and bring structure to ambiguity.
* Is confident conducting conversations with customers and stakeholders.
* Can advocate for users while understanding business realities.
* Uses research, data, and evidence to support design decisions.
* Is comfortable owning the UX process from discovery → definition → design → validation.
* Can balance user needs, business objectives, technology constraints, and feasibility.
* Has strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger experience.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience working on large\-scale digital products or enterprise platforms.
* Experience across web, mobile, or native applications.
* Experience in design systems and component\-based design.
* Experience facilitating design thinking workshops or discovery sessions.
* Exposure to accessibility and WCAG principles.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Experience using AI tools to accelerate UX research, ideation, prototyping, or analysis.


****What Success Looks Like****
 Within this role, you will be expected to:
   

  

**Understand → Define → Solve → Validate**
 You should be able to take a customer or business problem, understand it deeply, define the right UX problem, develop meaningful solutions, validate them, and clearly communicate the rationale behind your decisions.
   

  

**Core Attribute**
**We are looking for a UX designer who can do the UX heavy lifting — someone who understands customers deeply, speaks their language, owns the problem, and can turn complexity into simple, meaningful experiences.**
**If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.**
**Commitment to reaching all kinds of people**
 We design experiences that work for all kinds of people \- and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity \& Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.
   

  

****The Benefits****
 This is a
 **Fulltime** 
 position based in
 **Bangalore** 
 .
   

  

**Beyond a Competitive Compensation Package, We Offer:**
* Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country\-dependent)
* Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
* Learning and development, with access to cutting\-edge tools, training and industry experts


 Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.
   

  

**Your application process**
 Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

**Role Overview** 




 We are hiring a
 **Lead Product Designer / UX Pod Lead** 
 to drive end\-to\-end design strategy and execution for core modules of our Cloud HR Tech platform.
 



 In this "Player\-Coach" role, you will be the design anchor for a dedicated product pod. You will manage a small, agile team of 2 to 4 UX/UI designers while remaining fully hands\-on with high\-impact feature design, design systems, and complex product workflows. You will partner directly with Pod Leads, Engineering Managers, and Product Managers to build world\-class, enterprise\-grade SaaS experiences across web and mobile.
 



 If you are an experienced Senior/Lead Designer ready to own product strategy, mentor junior talent, and stay deeply connected to pixel\-perfect craft, this role is built for you. This position reports to the Senior Director of UX.
 



**RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* **Core Workflow Ownership:** 
 Take end\-to\-end ownership of complex, high\-priority HR tech modules (e.g., payroll engines, performance management, workforce analytics, mobile attendance).
* **High\-Fidelity Artifacts:** 
 Produce complete UX artifacts—from user journeys and wireframes to production\-ready Figma mockups, interactive prototypes, and micro\-interactions.
* **Design Systems:** 
 Drive the evolution of our centralized Figma Design System (tokens, auto\-layout, interactive components) and ensure component standardization across all pods.
* **AI\-First Workflows:** 
 Embed modern AI design tools (Figma AI, ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney) into the team’s day\-to\-day workflow to maximize design velocity and research automation.

* **Quality \& Governance:** 
 Set high standards for visual design, interaction quality, and design system usage across the team's output.
* **Sprint \& Capacity Planning:** 
 Allocate design resources within the pod, balance workload across sprint cycles, and ensure on\-time delivery of dev\-ready assets.
* **Process Optimization:** 
 Establish efficient dev\-handoff workflows, usability testing cadence, and cross\-functional alignment habits with engineering and product.



**LOOKING FOR** 



* **8 to 10 years** 
 of total experience in UX/UI design for enterprise SaaS, B2B cloud applications, or consumer\-scale mobile apps.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
**About Us:** 




  





 We are looking for a senior product designer who thinks in problems, not screens, and has rebuilt their workflow around AI to move faster than a traditional design process allows.
 



 Design here doesn't look like it did two years ago. Our designers prototype in code with AI, test ideas as working software instead of static mocks, and go from problem framing to a clickable prototype in hours, not weeks. Figma is still in the toolkit, but it's no longer where most of the thinking happens.
 



  





**How designers work here\-** 
 We've changed how design works here over the last couple of years. Instead of presenting static mocks, we build interactive HTML prototypes with AI and let stakeholders click through real flows, with real states and edge cases. Ideas get tested as working software early, which means we can explore several directions in the time it used to take to polish one. AI is part of every phase of our process: research, ideation, UX writing, prototyping, and design system work. We also invest in our own tooling and reusable workflows so the whole team keeps getting faster. But AI doesn't make the decisions. What ships still comes down to a designer's judgment about the user, the business, and the product.
 



  





**What Will You Do** 




  





 ● Own design problems from framing through shipping. You'll define the problem, explore directions, prototype, test, and work with engineering to get it live, without needing much oversight
 



 ● Work with Product and Engineering as a partner in shaping what gets built, including pushing back on requirements when the brief is solving the wrong problem
 



 ● Design for both sides of our platform, on web and mobile: the event experiences attendees see, and the data\-heavy tables, settings, and workflows organizers live in every day
 



 ● Build interactive prototypes with AI as part of your regular process, and help the team improve its tooling and workflows over time
 



 ● Contribute to our design system as you go, so the quality you add compounds instead of staying local to one feature
 



 ● Handle a few workstreams at once and decide your own priorities
 



 ● Give direct, useful critique, take it well, and explain your design decisions to people outside design
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




  





 ● 5 to 7 years of product design experience, at least 2 of them on B2B products
 



 ● Strong product judgment. You understand the business goal behind a request, question briefs that solve the wrong problem, and make trade\-offs between user needs, business outcomes, and engineering effort
 



 ● Depth in complex UX: multi\-step workflows, data\-dense interfaces, edge cases, and error and empty states
 



 ● Real experience shipping on both web and mobile, and comfort moving between the two: iOS/Android patterns, responsive behavior, platform constraints
 



 ● Fluent with AI in your daily workflow. It's a tool, not the job, but we expect it to be your default for exploration, prototyping, and iteration, and you should be able to show us how. Prototyping in code (HTML/CSS/React) is a plus
 



 ● High craft and speed together: a track record of moving fast in ambiguous environments without the work looking rushed
 



 ● A portfolio of recent, real work, ideally live products or interactive prototypes, with the thinking behind it, not just the output
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




  





 ● Competitive compensation
 



 ● Employee\-friendly ESOPs
 



 ● Remote working, with an option to rent coworking spaces
 



 ● Flexible leave program
 



 ● Home workstation setup allowance
 



 ● A culture built on trust, transparency, and integrity

title: Head of Design
description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world’s most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what’s next.
   

  

 Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next\-generation skills.
   

  

 People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.
   

  

**The role**
 HackerRank is hiring a Head of Design to define and own the experience for our platform and lead the organization responsible for delivering it. You will guide both traditional product experiences and emerging AI\-native and agentic experiences, through a team of product designers and design managers.
   

  

 As a member of Product, Engineering, and Design Leadership, you will serve as a strategic leader in the company. This role requires executive range and practitioner instincts. You should be able to move from an organizational question to a product strategy discussion, then into a working prototype or detailed interaction review without losing the thread between them. All of our leaders are builders.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Set experience strategy. Define the design vision for HackerRank’s platform and turn company strategy into a clear experience direction. Connect near\-term product decisions to a coherent view of where technical hiring and developer skills are going. Keep the organization close to customers and developers, using research, product data, prototypes, and direct observation to shape the work.
* Drive AI and agentic fluency. Shape how people interact with AI across the platform, from embedded intelligence to autonomous agents. Establish rigor around AI experience evals, agentic specifications, and emerging interaction practices. Set the expectation that designers experiment with models, agents, and code\-adjacent tools—and model that behavior yourself.
* Be the quality bar. Raise the quality and coherence of HackerRank’s end\-to\-end experience. Guide the information architecture, workflows, interaction patterns, and systems that make the platform feel like one product. Have a clear point of view on what good looks like, make that standard practical, and raise the quality of everything HackerRank ships.Drive strategic partnership. Operate as a peer to Product and Engineering leadership. Shape product strategy, investment priorities, and roadmaps; clarify the problems worth solving; and make the trade\-offs required to balance customer value, technical reality, speed, and long\-term platform quality.Build and lead the team. Lead an organization that includes product designers and design managers. Hire and develop strong leaders, establish clear ownership, raise the quality of critique and decision\-making, and create an environment where designers can move quickly without lowering the bar.


**How You Will Lead**
 We expect you to get close to the work. You see yourself as a maker who can lead others through ambiguity, and you proactively spend time building with models and agents and shipping your work.
   

  

 You do not need to be a production engineer. You do need enough technical curiosity and fluency to prototype alongside engineers, explore ideas with modern AI and coding tools, and understand how model behavior, architecture, latency, cost, data, and evaluation shape the experience.
   

  

 You should be comfortable developing your own perspective on the product and market. You can communicate that perspective clearly to non\-designers and build support for improvements across the experience, from broad product strategy to the smallest interaction details.
   

  

 You have led senior designers and design managers, and you know how to raise the quality of the work without slowing the team down. Build early. Put ideas in front of customers. Learn from real behavior. Refine from evidence.
   

  

**Requirements And Experience We Are Looking For**
* A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates strong judgment, leadership, and high\-quality execution. Show us what shipped, what changed, and the role you played.
* Significant product design experience, including ownership of complex products or platforms and several years leading designers and design managers.
* A track record of building and developing strong design organizations, including hiring senior talent, coaching managers, clarifying ownership, and improving the overall caliber of the team.
* Experience partnering with senior Product and Engineering leaders to shape strategy, prioritize investments, and turn ambiguous opportunities into shipped products.
* Direct experience delivering AI\-powered products, agentic experiences, or other non\-deterministic systems.
* A hands\-on approach. You enjoy getting into the work, making ideas tangible, and helping teams ship stronger results.
* Fluency with modern design and prototyping tools, including demonstrated use of AI, code\-adjacent tools, or working software to explore and communicate ideas. Framer experience is a plus.
